cards.flavor: As you hole the silhouette in your hand, you hear faint whispers on the wind.
cards.name: Faded Silhouette
cards.text: Permanent. Forced - During the setup of each scenario, search the collection for Madeline Usher and shuffle her into the encounter deck.

cards.flavor: "...but, feeling the rain upon his shoulders, and fearing the rising of the tempest, uplifted his mace outright..."
cards.name: The Mad Trist
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [combat].
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust The Mad Trist: Move to a connecting location and heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.flavor: "...but, feeling the rain upon his shoulders, and fearing the rising of the tempest, uplifted his mace outright..."
cards.name: The Mad Trist
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust The Mad Trist: Move up to 2 clues from connecting locations to your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Your next investigate action this round does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
